adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration reads prior `site_settings.value` for `embeddable_hosts` and interpolates each line directly into a raw SQL `execute` string: `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`. Because `h` is not escaped/quoted via connection helpers, any host containing a single quote (or other SQL-significant characters) can break the migration and could enable SQL injection in the migration context. The diff also adds no tests covering this migration/data-conversion path or the `embed_category`/uncategorized fallback behavior, so regressions there wouldn’t be caught.
